screens.name: Home — populated and unavailable omen, normal/200%, transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 18 and 34 show complete omen variants and a dominant orb; supplied browser evidence reports enlarged-layout and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Increase the faint sample-question contrast and give the unavailable omen a more useful explanation than returning tomorrow.

screens.name: Approach — normal/200% and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 preserves the orb and opening message across captures but provides no screen-specific timing or completion evidence.
findings: Verify that the opening state completes promptly and expose recovery if it stalls.

screens.name: Question composer — self and named person, normal/200%, transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–03 and 48–49 show the recipient, disclosure, labeled question and clear submit action; supplied evidence reports retained drafts and visible return focus.
findings: Reduce the vertical gap between the header and recipient row at normal size to make the composition feel more intentional.

screens.name: Question composer — constrained viewport and long draft
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows the label, internally scrolled draft and submit within letterboxed 500px viewports; supplied evidence reports exact draft preservation.
findings: Make internal text scrolling more apparent so a long draft ending mid-word does not look truncated.

screens.name: Question composer — disclosure retrieval and provider consent
screens.evidence: Sheets 09 and 15 show retrieved disclosure and an off consent switch, while supplied controlled-provider evidence reports blocked submission before consent.
findings: Keep a concise explanation of the consent requirement near the disabled submit action when the full disclosure is above the viewport.

screens.name: Recipient editor — self/someone selection and named-person input
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 and 19 show a checked recipient choice, labeled name and privacy explanation; supplied evidence covers empty-name, cancel and return-focus behavior.
findings: Bring the name field's square focus treatment into the same visual family as the question field while retaining a clear focus indicator.

screens.name: Adaptive question 1 — choices, normal/200%, transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows progress and four answer rows, with the enlarged heading occupying much of the viewport.
findings: Align the response scale so progress labels such as 'Halfway there' answer the same concept as 'Nearly certain'.

screens.name: Adaptive question 2 — choices, normal/200%, transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show a readable obstacle question, consistent answer rows and explicit second-step progress.
findings: Capture a selected or pressed answer state to complete the otherwise clear progression evidence.

screens.name: Adaptive question 3 — reveal choices, normal/200%, transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 clearly distinguish the final step with 'Choose an answer to reveal' and third-step progress.
findings: Demonstrate the immediate acknowledgment between selecting the final answer and entering forecast loading.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, filled, long and constrained variants
screens.evidence: Sheets 06 and 14–15 show disabled empty submission and enabled Reveal with retained question context in constrained layouts.
findings: Remove 'Write a few words to continue' once a valid answer enables Reveal.

screens.name: Planning and research — loading, normal/200%, transitions
screens.evidence: Sheets 27–28 explain the current stage, expected wait, credit protection and cancellation; supplied evidence reports reduced-motion and entrance checks.
findings: Add fresh round-specific evidence for cancellation and recovery after the stated one-minute wait.

screens.name: Plan generation error
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a distinct failure, credit reassurance, primary retry and secondary question editing in both text sizes.
findings: Record a current failure-to-retry result so the recovery path has evidence beyond its visible controls.

screens.name: Forecast generation error
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 add Review answers to the retry and edit choices without visually presenting failure as success.
findings: Demonstrate that retry and answer review preserve all supplied answers after this error.

screens.name: Voice entry — microphone startup failure
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 offers a prominent typing fallback and voice retry, but supplied evidence leaves actual microphone behavior unverified.
findings: Explain where to change microphone permission when retry alone cannot resolve the failure.

screens.name: Age confirmation
screens.evidence: Sheets 20–21 show two clear age responses with substantial unused space beneath the short form.
findings: Replace 'Teen-safe defaults apply' with a brief explanation of what that means for the user.

screens.name: Onboarding birthday — optional entry
screens.evidence: Sheets 21–22 show labeled date parts, optional status and skip, with fields stacking at 200% and actions below the initial viewport.
findings: Reduce nonessential vertical spacing in the enlarged date form so Continue and Skip require less scrolling.

screens.name: Onboarding — age blocked
screens.evidence: Sheet 22 clearly explains the age restriction and offers birthday correction at both sizes.
findings: Use age-answer wording when this screen follows the age confirmation rather than a entered birthday.

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday correction
screens.evidence: Sheet 23 provides a correction explanation, labeled date fields, Check birthday and a return action.
findings: Capture invalid-date and successful-correction states to establish the recovery feedback for this form.

screens.name: Onboarding focus — unselected and selected
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–25 show a checkmark and underline for selection and a primary label that changes from skipping to meeting the Ball.
findings: Tighten enlarged heading spacing so the primary action is not initially cut by the viewport edge.

screens.name: Reveal — forecast result
screens.evidence: Sheets 39–41 show the speculative label, forecast, reminder and sharing action, with multiple secondary actions below.
findings: Group Edit question and Review answers under one revision action to reduce competing choices after the reveal.

screens.name: Check-in — forecast collapsed and expanded
screens.evidence: Sheets 07–08 and 35 show forecast context above three outcome choices, with expansion pushing those choices below the enlarged viewport.
findings: Keep the outcome question easier to reach after expanding a forecast at 200% text.

screens.name: Check-in — saved yes, no and pending outcomes
screens.evidence: Sheets 25 and 36–37 show explicit Saved text, checked choices and distinct pending guidance; supplied retained evidence reports persisted, correctable outcomes.
findings: Preserve the explicit Saved label and non-color selection marker across all outcome variants.

screens.name: Evidence overview
screens.evidence: Sheets 39 and 49 separate explanation, answers, assumptions and sources with counts and navigation chevrons.
findings: Remove or clarify the extra Read the forecast disclosure when Back to forecast already supplies that destination.

screens.name: Evidence — answers
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 and 47–48 show long answer bodies, with question labels in layout captures and generic Answer numbers in verified captures.
findings: Keep the original question as the heading for each answer so its meaning survives navigation into this reader.

screens.name: Evidence — assumptions
screens.evidence: Sheets 12 and 48 show a dedicated assumptions reader with return navigation and enlarged text; repeated stress prose is explicitly synthetic.
findings: Present multiple assumptions as separate items when available instead of one uninterrupted paragraph.

screens.name: Evidence — legacy reason passages
screens.evidence: Sheets 13, 40 and 49–50 divide preserved legacy prose into neutral Passage sections and visibly retain navigation context.
findings: Add a concise orientation sentence explaining that these passages are the recorded explanation for this reading.

screens.name: Evidence — authored context, assumption and limits
screens.evidence: Sheet 29 explicitly separates recorded context, scenario assumption and absence of external outcome support in retained authored-reading captures.
findings: Use this explicit context–assumption–limits structure consistently for newly authored explanations.

screens.name: Evidence — current sources
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 and 50 show publisher, date, source body and external link alongside an explicit background-only limitation.
findings: Give each source a concise title above its body so long source lists are easier to scan.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show an uncluttered empty state with an Ask the Ball action and device-storage explanation.
findings: Retain the direct invitation and storage explanation as history gains additional empty or filtered states.

screens.name: History — populated, stress list and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 distinguish date, question, forecast, reminder and saved outcome, while the enlarged forecast consumes most of the first viewport.
findings: Reduce enlarged row spacing so Open check-in follows the forecast with less scrolling.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples and selected question
screens.evidence: Sheet 46 labels offline samples and selection, replacing the spatial star arrangement with ordered rows at 200%.
findings: Add a short invitation to choose a star so the normal-size constellation's interactivity is immediately evident.

screens.name: Circles — offline empty surface
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show offline messaging, Retry, disabled creation and an unavailable eligibility switch without claiming online success.
findings: Remove repeated circle-sharing explanation and clarify whose eligibility the disabled switch refers to.

screens.name: Plans — yearly and monthly selected, test mode
screens.evidence: Sheets 26–27 clearly label simulated purchases and selected plans, with billing terms and pack alternatives visible at normal size.
findings: Repeat the selected billing amount in the primary action so confirmation remains self-contained after scrolling.

screens.name: Sensitive-question interruption — planning and prediction
screens.evidence: Sheets 41–42 prioritize support, offer alternative-question recovery and state that no reading or memory entry was used.
findings: Move the brief explanation before the support button so users understand the offered destination before acting.

screens.name: Share — preview and expanded invite options
screens.evidence: Sheets 44–46 show preview enlargement, image-text access, download and a clear statement of excluded private information.
findings: Give the small preview a clearer readable summary and ensure headings remain unobscured beneath the fixed header when scrolled.

screens.name: Share — preparing, completed and failed export
screens.evidence: Sheets 37–38 distinguish preparation, download started and retryable failure; supplied retained evidence describes actual canvas export recovery.
findings: Verify assistive announcement of each export status while preserving the accurate 'download started' wording.

screens.name: Shared image inspection and story
screens.evidence: Sheets 43 and 47 show a cohesive full-size card with forecast, speculative label and branding at both interface text sizes.
findings: Keep a readily available text alternative because text embedded in the exported image does not enlarge with interface text.

screens.name: Share — image-text reader
screens.evidence: Sheet 45 provides the image's forecast and limitation as enlarged interface text above Download image.
findings: Add spacing between the download button and repeated image preview to preserve their distinct roles.

screens.name: You — birth profile, plan and memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 52 groups birth profile, plan allowance and editable remembered focus, with enlarged profile actions occupying most of the initial viewport.
findings: Reduce repeated separators and oversized vertical gaps so profile, plan and memory remain easier to survey at 200%.

screens.name: Settings controls
screens.evidence: Sheets 42–43 show labeled sound, motion and text switches; supplied browser evidence reports reduced-motion/resume checks.
findings: Visually distinguish Forget everything from ordinary navigation actions.

screens.name: Birthday editing
screens.evidence: Sheets 19 and 51–52 show populated date parts, save, cancellation and birthday removal, with save below the initial enlarged viewport.
findings: Compress enlarged field spacing and replace the ambiguous '+' beside Remove birthday with an explicit disclosure indicator.

screens.name: Birth details — initial and city search results
screens.evidence: Sheets 31–32 and 50–51 show optional time, city search, disambiguated locations and a guarded save action; supplied retained evidence covers live lookup.
findings: Clarify whether birth time is required for calculation and bring that requirement next to the disabled save explanation.

screens.name: Birth details — invalid time, no results and service failure
screens.evidence: Sheets 30 and 32 distinguish time validation, empty search and failed search with specific recovery actions.
findings: Preserve the complete field label in view when scrolling to an enlarged validation error.

screens.name: Birth details — saved, retried and forgotten
screens.evidence: Sheets 31 and 33 show explicit saved and forgotten confirmations, retained birthday messaging and a prominent Done action.
findings: Capitalize sign names consistently and ensure edit/forget controls can scroll fully clear of the tab bar.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home and loading captures consistently feature the illustrated orb, and supplied evidence reports motion and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Keep the actionable Home orb clearly distinguished from decorative instances through its adjacent instruction and accessible name.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main-screen captures show persistent labels and an underlined selected tab; supplied control checks report 44×44 targets.
findings: Verify every enlarged scroll endpoint clears the raised center orb and fixed tab bar.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: The header consistently pairs a title or Close with allowance/test status, with allowance wrapping onto two lines at 200%.
findings: Reduce the balance block's visual weight at large text so it does not compete with the screen task.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream buttons remain distinctive across enabled, disabled, retry and enlarged states; supplied evidence reports target-size checks.
findings: Add representative pressed-state evidence to complement the strong enabled and disabled treatments.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Secondary actions alternate between centered white text, gold links and divided rows across the supplied screens.
findings: Assign one consistent treatment to navigation and another to secondary commands.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question cards use spacious divided rows, while outcome and focus selections demonstrate non-color checkmarks.
findings: Show immediate selection acknowledgment for choices that automatically advance.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Composer captures show a persistent label, unfocused outline and strong focus ring; supplied evidence reports exact draft retention and 18/26-to-36/52 scaling.
findings: Retain the contiguous label–field–submit group and visible unfocused boundary.

components.name: Large-text and constrained input
components.evidence: Constrained captures retain usable input and submission space, but long values visibly enter an internal scroll position.
findings: Expose a subtle internal-scroll cue and verify caret visibility with a physical keyboard viewport.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Settings and consent captures show contrasting knob positions and labeled rows, with supplied target-size and axe checks.
findings: Verify that each label activates its switch and that its changed state is announced.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 18 and 34 distinguish free populated and unavailable content without displacing the primary orb.
findings: Explain unavailable content more specifically when a known cause or retry opportunity exists.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 46 shows a checked star category, matching question and enlarged list alternative.
findings: Make category selection discoverable with a short instruction near the constellation.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Circles captures explicitly show offline creation and eligibility states with a separate Retry action.
findings: Consolidate the duplicate sharing description and explain the disabled eligibility control.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: History captures distinguish source question, forecast, reminder and saved outcome using consistent rows.
findings: Keep the row's check-in action closer to long enlarged forecasts.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Yearly and monthly captures use both a checkmark and gold rule while showing total charge and billing interval.
findings: Carry the selected total and interval into the confirmation button.

components.name: Share preview card
components.evidence: Sharing captures pair a small card with enlargement and image-text alternatives, while inspection captures expose the complete design.
findings: Use a larger preview or nearby forecast summary so users can inspect its content without an extra navigation step.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error, offline, validation and export screens provide specific visible states and recovery choices.
findings: Verify status announcements and focus placement for each dynamically appearing notice.

components.name: Typography system
components.evidence: The serif display/sans body pairing is consistent, while enlarged titles and long forecast text often dominate the viewport.
findings: Tune spacing independently of text scaling so 200% layouts preserve a comfortable task rhythm.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and warm lower glow remain consistent, and supplied evidence reports text contrast, reduced motion and isolated ambient performance checks.
findings: Preserve calm low-detail regions behind reading text as atmospheric treatments evolve.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Date fields have explicit Day, Month and Year labels and reflow vertically at 200%, but invalid-date examples are not pictured.
findings: Add demonstrated invalid-date feedback and reduce enlarged vertical field gaps.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: The age screen visibly offers explicit older/younger responses, with a separate blocked screen represented.
findings: Document the action-to-result transition for each age response.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Selected focus has a checkmark and underline, and the continuation label reflects whether a choice exists.
findings: Preserve the explicit selection marker and optional-skip wording.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: You and saved-chart captures separate birth data, calculated signs and editing actions.
findings: Standardize sign capitalization and tighten spacing around profile editing actions.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Represented states include lookup results, validation, failure, retry, saved and forgotten details with supplied retained live-drive evidence.
findings: State all prerequisites beside the disabled calculation action and keep validation context visible.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Identity captures show selection, a labeled first-name field and privacy context; supplied checks cover empty-name and retained-question transitions.
findings: Unify the name field's focus styling with the question composer.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Overview rows, expansion arrows and dedicated readers expose different evidence categories without claiming sources verify the prediction.
findings: Use consistent navigation semantics and retain question context when opening answer details.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Retained captures and supplied runtime evidence distinguish preparation, failure, retry and download-start acknowledgment.
findings: Confirm live-region announcements for progress, failure and completion without moving focus unexpectedly.

components.name: Close/back and modal-style screen shell
components.evidence: Task screens retain Close or Back above scrolling content, with several scrolled captures showing headings partially behind the fixed header.
findings: Verify focus destinations and scroll offsets so navigation never leaves the active heading or control hidden beneath the header.

limitations: These are provisional browser grades based on the supplied screenshots and runtime account; no independent runtime drive or file inspection was performed.
Corresponding transition captures were grouped with settled states; their visible composition is consistent, but still images do not establish continuous animation or focus behavior.
Supplied evidence reports 270 layout/text states, 1686 controls meeting 44×44, contrast checks, zero page errors and reduced-motion checks; those results were not independently reproduced.
Retained31 captures were evaluated only as expressly supplied unchanged-state evidence, not as fresh round-32 verification.
The 500px constrained-form captures are intentionally letterboxed; content below an ordinary viewport was not treated as proven unreachable or lost.
Synthetic prediction, source and stress-text fixtures were not treated as production-copy failures or proof of model quality.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native text scaling, actual keyboard, microphone, haptics, real payments and OS sharing remain unverified; browser scores do not certify those boundaries.
Circles has offline-state evidence only; no functioning production authentication, invitation or online-circle experience is established.
No hard-gate failure is established by these materials, but missing interaction evidence prevents an unconditional gate pass.
Using the specified dimension means and weighting, the required A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components.
topFixes: Improve 200% spacing on birthday, profile, history and expanded-forecast screens without reducing text enlargement.
Clarify consent-dependent disabled submission when its explanatory disclosure is above the constrained viewport.
Keep original question labels in answer readers and simplify duplicate forecast navigation.
Unify secondary-action and input-focus styling across forms and detail screens.
Complete current browser evidence for pressed/selected transitions, error recovery, status announcements and unobscured focus.
